desc: Notice is hereby given that the 53rd Annual General Meeting (AGM) of the Members of Milkfood Limited will be held at the Registered Office of the Company at P.O. Bahadurgarh, District Patiala, Punjab-147021 on Thursday, the 24th September, 2026 at 9.00 a.m.

Pursuant to Regulation 34(1)(a) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, please find enclosed herewith the Annual Report of the Company for the financial year ended 31st March, 2026.

Pursuant to the provisions of Section 91 of the Companies Act, 2013 read with Companies (Management and Administration) Rules, 2014 and Regulation 42 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, the Register of Members and Share transfer Books of the Company will remain closed from 17th September, 2026 to 24th September, 2026 (both days inclusive) for the purpose of Annual General Meeting scheduled to be held on Thursday, the 24th September, 2026 at 9.00 a.m. at the Registered Office of the Company.

In compliance with Regulation 36(1)(b) of the SEBI Listing Regulations, the Company has initiated dispatch of letter to those shareholders whose e-mail addresses are not registered with Company/RTA, providing the weblink of Company''s website where the Annual Report for the FY 2025-26 has been uploaded.
